description: DRAFT (11-11 ~16:20): create only once chessai-hybrid14 is verified (the user: 'only after the optimizations are in'); then set the tournament binary to chessai-hybrid14 and move the DAG lines' training to it if it trains them byte-identically (train_binary.py --from chessai-errdag4 LDIR chessai-hybrid14), and F-L/F-P to chessai-hybrid6 (train_binary.py --from chessai-hybrid4gfx LDIR). The user's global league (11-10 design, built 11-11 13:50) with the eight of 11-11 ~16:20 ('let's take 8 models forward'), untrained, at ply 1 ('in the global league they should be on ply 1 because that's the ply we tested them on'): F-L, F-P, the fresh-gate cluster trees T-P-Nc-merge-fresh and T-L-Nc-merge-fresh (limit 4, 1M; probit noise 0.03), and the error DAGs (NB error routers, path context, leaf limit 4 plus router limit 4, 1M; probit noise 0.03) with probit leaves at router-split z 30 and z 20 and with LR leaves at z 160 and z 120 (z 30 and z 160 as in error-dag-probit-p1 and error-dag-p1; z 20 and z 120 the user's lower thresholds). Rules: current and champion entries at each model's ply, training on games where both players are rated at or above the model's Elo minus 30, self-games, patience by training positions (20M, 5-cycle floor, every model), the four random references, 5 double round-robins a cycle.
